about_the_game:
Alex's quiet life in a small Québec town starts to unravel when strange things start happening. People go missing. Buildings change overnight. And weird, twisted creatures start roaming the streets. It’s clear something is wrong and it all seems to point to Lumina Corporation, the shady tech giant with a hidden presence in town.

Incoherence is a survival-exploration game inspired by classics like Silent Hill and System Shock. You'll scavenge for supplies, craft tools, and piece together what’s really going on as the world around you slowly dives into madness.

As Alex digs deeper, with the help of his partner Astrid, an ex-Lumina employee, he'll uncover a disturbing link between himself, the town, and the nightmare creeping in. But some answers come with a price, and he might not be ready to pay it.

Key Features

  • Immerse yourself in a first-person adventure, rich in detail and atmosphere.

  • Equip a variety of classic weapons, each with unique strengths and abilities.

  • Interact with complex NPCs, adding depth to the unfolding story.

  • Encounter diverse monsters, testing your combat skills and strategies.

  • Evolve your character through RPG elements, with leveling and skill trees.

  • Tailor your arsenal with weapon upgrades to suit your playstyle.

  • Unearth blueprints and use found materials to craft vital resources.

  • Explore computer systems and find notes that piece together the game's narrative and open new pathways.

  • Overcome challenges by repairing and hacking robots and security systems.

  • Collect in-game currency scattered throughout the world for use at various vendors.
